scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock'].forEach(file => { try { fs.unlinkSync(file); } catch (err) { if (err.code !== 'ENOENT') throw err; }});"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
